### RESEARCH INTERESTS

\vspace{2pt}
\hrule
\vspace{4pt}

- Resistance and resilience of aquatic ecosystems to anthropogenic stressors, particularly emerging infectious diseases and nonnative species.
- Impacts of nonnative species on the structure and function of aquatic ecosystems.
- Developing effective strategies to recover endangered amphibians.
